capabilities: Select rows in a Bases table view and edit them as a batch
Preview old and new property values per note before applying
Set, append, remove or replace list items, including tag renames
Apply writes with file-change conflict checks and skipped-note reasons
Undo the last applied batch from the view or command palette
extras: Freemium: Pro (saved actions, 20 undo batches) requires a $5/month or $15 one-time GitHub Sponsors payment and GitHub sign-in; free features work offline with no account. Undo history is in-memory and lost on restart. Apply re-serializes frontmatter, so YAML comments, quoting and key order can change. After updates it opens a promotional tab suggesting other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat.
intentEvidence: Choose the Multi-row edit view in a Base.
problem: Obsidian's Bases tables have no built-in way to change one property across many notes at once, so users must edit each note's frontmatter separately.

relations.evidence: Requires Obsidian 1.13.4 or newer with the core Bases plugin enabled.

summary: Bulk property editor for Bases tables that sets, appends, removes or replaces a property across selected rows with a per-note preview and undo.
